## about-us (en-US)

Path: /about-us/

FROM HUMBLE BEGINNINGS
TO A
GLOBAL PRESENCE
We’re Humans was founded in Doncaster, UK, in 2003 as a small graphic design studio serving the local market. From the outset, the focus was simple: do good work, build trust, and form long-term client relationships. As the industry evolved, so did we. What began as design-led work evolved into something deeper—platforms, products, and systems that required a more technical and strategic approach. As our client base expanded, we looked beyond the UK and established a permanent presence in Pattaya, Thailand, where the next phase of the business took shape. Today, We’re Humans operates globally, with teams in the UK and Thailand, supporting organisations across multiple markets.
BRANCHING OUT:
EXPANDING OUR CAPABILITIES
Our evolution wasn’t overnight. It came through experience, changing client needs, and a clear ambition to build things properly.
Over time, our work expanded beyond design to include web platforms, applications, and integrated systems that support real-world business operations. This naturally expanded our capabilities into areas such as platform development, system integration, performance, and ongoing technical support — not as bolt-on services, but as part of building reliable, scalable solutions.
This progression reflects how our clients operate today—and how systems must perform long after launch.
A CLIENT-FOCUSED APPROACH,
GLOBALLY​
What continues to set We’re Humans apart is how closely we work with our clients. We don’t apply one-size-fits-all solutions or pre-packaged approaches. Every project starts with understanding how an organisation works, what it needs to support, and where it’s heading.
We work with organisations of all sizes across a wide range of sectors, locally and internationally. That breadth of experience allows us to design and build systems that are not only effective but also appropriate to each industry and use case.
LOOKING FORWARD
.
Our commitment remains unchanged: to design and build systems that are reliable, considered, and built to last.
Our team has grown steadily from a small group of designers to a multidisciplinary team of over 25 designers, engineers, and specialists. We continue to grow carefully, focusing on capability and quality rather than scale for its own sake.
We’re Humans isn’t here to chase trends or campaigns. We’re here to build systems organisations can rely on — now and into the future.
LET’S START A CONVERSATION
If you have a project you’d like to discuss or need additional capacity to support your team, we’d be happy to talk.

How we build
Sometimes AI is the right answer. Sometimes
it isn't.
Our job is to understand the problem first, then recommend a sensible approach no hype, no AI for the sake of AI. Often the best move is to find one useful opportunity, build it properly, measure whether it delivers real value, and let it grow from there. You don’t need an organisation-wide AI strategy to start.

Design, Content & Growth

Privacy, Security & Compliance
AI raises real questions about data and access: what a model can see, where data lives, and who can use it. We design for them from the start.
Human

Our approach to AI

problems.

Keep those people in control. Consider privacy, security and compliance from the beginning. And build something that can evolve as your understanding grows. ## cookie-policy-2025 (en-US)

Path: /cookie-policy-2025/

Human Digital Solutions is committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring transparency about how we use cookies on our website. This Cookies Policy explains what cookies are, how we use them, and how you can manage your preferences.
What Are Cookies?
When you visit a website, cookies are small text files stored on your device (computer, tablet, or smartphone). They help websites function effectively, improve user experience, and provide insights into user behaviour.
How We Use Cookies
We use cookies for the following purposes:
Essential Cookies: Our website must function correctly and cannot be disabled. For example, they enable navigation and access to secure areas.
Performance Cookies: These help us understand how visitors interact with our site by collecting anonymous data, allowing us to improve functionality and design.
Functionality Cookies: These allow us to remember your preferences and settings, enhancing your browsing experience.
Analytics Cookies: We use third-party cookies (e.g., Google Analytics) to collect website traffic and usage data to improve our services.
Marketing Cookies: Occasionally, we use cookies to deliver relevant advertisements or track the effectiveness of our campaigns.
Managing Cookies
You can control or disable cookies through your browser settings. Please note that restricting certain cookies may affect the functionality and usability of our website.
Here are links to manage cookies on popular browsers:
Google Chrome
Mozilla Firefox
Safari
Microsoft Edge
Third-Party Cookies
Our website may include third-party features or integrations like social media platforms or analytics services. These third parties may set their cookies, which we do not control.
Contact Us
If you have any questions about this Cookies Policy or our use of cookies, don’t hesitate to get in touch with us at:
Human Digital Solutions Address: 519 / 163 – 164 Moo6. Soi Siam Country Club, Nongprue, Banglamung, Chon Buri 20150
Email:
sales@werehumans.in.th

## our-work (en-US)

Path: /our-work/

GECKO PROPERTY
Website Development, Bespoke Systems & Ongoing SEO
Were Humans transferred this real estate client onto our bespoke real estate system several years ago and have been working closely with them ever since. The platform was designed to support a growing property portfolio while delivering a reliable and intuitive experience for both agents and customers.
More recently, we updated and refined the website's front end to reflect evolving trends in the modern real estate market. These improvements support the client’s commitment to providing a user-friendly website that appeals to a worldwide audience, including international investors, expatriates, and the local market.
Were Humans continues to support the business with ongoing development, monthly SEO, and continuous optimisation, helping maintain strong online visibility while ensuring the website evolves in line with market expectations.
Steven Schole, When I started my new business and needed a new website, I was referred to Human I.T. by a friend. From our very first meeting, I was impressed by their professionalism and approach to building my new business website, Gecko Properties. They listened to my ideas, and together we built a great website that, to this day, I receive compliments on its functionality and ease of use. They have now started to take care of my SEO work and so far the results are very promising. ​
FPT Global
Website Design & Managed IT Services
FPT Global is a leading provider of project logistics and consultancy solutions across Thailand and neighbouring countries. Since beginning operations in 2017, they have built a strong reputation for delivering complex logistics solutions, supported by a management team with over 30 years of regional experience.
Were Humans initially designed and built the FPT Global website, and continue to support the business with ongoing managed IT services and on-site technical support. Our work includes maintaining internal systems across multiple office floors, supporting day-to-day operations, and managing system upgrades and security.
Through a combination of digital support and hands-on IT management, Were Humans helps ensure FPT Global’s technology infrastructure remains reliable, secure, and aligned with the demands of a fast-moving logistics operation.
SBD Thailand
E-commerce Website, Content Creation & Ongoing Digital Support
Were Humans was approached to take the lead in creating the digital presence for SBD Thailand at a time when no local distributor was in place. Working closely with the brand and strictly adhering to global SBD brand guidelines, we collaborated with the UK team to ensure the Thai market launch aligned seamlessly with SBD Apparel's international identity.
We designed and built a full WooCommerce e-commerce platform to support the brand's launch in Thailand, providing a strong foundation for selling and promoting the complete SBD product range. Alongside the website, Were Humans developed and continues to deliver all product content, visual assets, and marketing materials used across digital channels.
Ongoing support includes regular site updates, content creation, and marketing initiatives across social and media platforms, helping to establish and grow SBD Thailand as a trusted local destination for the world’s leading strength sports equipment.
Audio Visual Automation
Website Design, E-commerce & Digital Marketing
Were Humans has worked with Audio Visual Automation for a number of years, initially maintaining their existing website before recently designing and building a brand-new platform. The new website delivers an expanded online experience, showcasing over 1,000 products and focusing specifically on the Australian market.
Audio Visual Automation was founded by Stuart Ford, a highly experienced systems designer and programmer with over 18 years in the industry. The business specialises in high-end residential and commercial automation solutions, creating intelligent environments that simplify and enhance the way people interact with technology. From bespoke home cinema installations to fully integrated automation systems controlling lighting, security, blinds, and access, Audio Visual Automation sets the benchmark for luxury smart living.
Alongside the website rebuild, Were Humans continues to support Audio Visual Automation through ongoing social media content creation and the management of targeted advertising campaigns across Facebook and Meta platforms. This combined digital approach strengthens their online presence, promotes their extensive product range, and reaches new audiences in a competitive market.
Global Property & Insurance
Global Property and Insurance is a long-standing client for whom we have designed, built, and continue to evolve a fully bespoke digital platform supporting both their real estate and insurance operations.
We developed two tightly integrated, custom-built website systems — one for property and one for insurance — each supported by robust, purpose-built backend architectures. The insurance platform, in particular, has been developed in close collaboration with the client to accurately model real-world operational workflows, data management requirements, and regulatory considerations.
The backend system enables structured management of policyholder data, end-to-end policy lifecycle tracking, renewals, and reporting. Staff can view customer and policy information at a glance, supported by automated alerts for upcoming renewals, expirations, and key customer milestones (including policy anniversaries and birthday-based triggers, where relevant). Ongoing enhancements focus on improving data capture, reducing manual processing, and streamlining internal workflows around policy administration and renewal forecasting.
The platform continues to evolve as new operational requirements are identified, with regular additions of bespoke workflows designed to improve efficiency, accuracy, and overall customer experience. The overarching objective is continuous improvement, ensuring staff have clear visibility, actionable insights, and minimal friction in day-to-day policy management.
Alongside platform development, we provide ongoing digital marketing support, including monthly SEO services, social media management, and broader campaign support. This ensures sustained organic visibility, consistent lead generation, and an online presence aligned with the client’s operational capabilities and customer expectations.
Take Care Kids Foundation
Website Design & Ongoing Support
When Were Humans was first approached by Take Care Kids Foundation, they were seeking help to create a website that could tell their full story and truly represent everything the organisation stands for. We were proud to support the project from the outset and contributed our work pro bono as part of our commitment to the foundation’s mission.
Take Care Kids is a volunteer-based organisation dedicated to protecting children — and in certain cases single mothers with children — from violence and severe abuse, while helping them rebuild their lives and create a safer future. We designed and built a website that clearly communicates this purpose and provides a strong digital foundation for their work.
Were Humans continues to maintain and support the website going forward, helping ensure the foundation has a reliable platform to share their story, raise awareness, and reach those in need.
White Label
.
White-Label Payment Gateway
Platform Architecture & System Development
Were Humans designed and developed a complete white-label payment gateway platform, built to enable businesses to accept online payments securely across websites, applications, and popular e-commerce platforms. The project was delivered as a scalable, end-to-end system capable of supporting merchants, developers, and end users within a single ecosystem.
The platform includes a robust payment gateway core, a secure merchant portal for transaction management and reporting, developer tools for API-based integrations, and support for multiple payment flows and methods. This allows merchants to offer seamless checkout experiences while maintaining high standards of security, automation, and reliability.
Designed for flexibility and growth, the system supports modern payment requirements, integrates with trusted third-party providers, and provides real-time transaction updates and automated notifications. The result is a powerful, enterprise-ready payment solution delivered under a fully white-labelled framework.

## privacy-policy-2025 (en-US)

Path: /privacy-policy-2025/

Last Updated:
Jan 2025
Human Digital Solutions is committed to safeguarding your privacy and handling your personal information securely and responsibly. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when you use our website or services, including digital marketing, SEO, IT services, graphic design, website design, and application development.
Information We Collect
We may collect and process the following types of information:
Personal Information:
When you contact us, request a quote, or use our services, we provide your name, email address, phone number, and company details. If you have access to a client portal or account, we also provide login credentials.
Service-Related Information
Project details, preferences, and files are shared with us for design, development, or IT services.
Usage Data
How you interact with our website includes IP address, browser type, device information, visited pages, time spent on pages, and referral sources.
Cookies and Tracking Data
We use cookies and similar technologies to enhance your experience, analyse website traffic, and track the performance of our services. (For more details, see our Cookies Policy.
How We Use Your Information
We use the information collected for purposes including:
Providing Services
Delivering digital marketing, graphic design, application development, and IT solutions tailored to your needs.
Improving User Experience
Enhancing our website’s functionality, usability, and content to meet user expectations.
Communications
Responding to your inquiries, providing project updates, and sharing relevant information.
Sending promotional emails or updates about our services only with your explicit consent.
Compliance and Security:
We ensure compliance with legal obligations, protect our rights and prevent unauthorised access to or misuse of our services.
How We Protect Your Information
We implement robust security measures to protect your data from unauthorised access, alteration, or disclosure, including:
Secure servers and encrypted storage for sensitive information.
Regular monitoring and updates to our systems to prevent vulnerabilities.
Access control policies to ensure only authorised personnel handle your data.
Sharing Your Information
We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information. However, we may share your data with:
Trusted Service Providers:
Third parties that assist us in delivering services, such as cloud hosting, analytics, or IT support.
Legal or Regulatory Authorities:
If required by law or to protect our legal rights or the safety of others.
Your Rights
You have the following rights regarding your data:
Access:
Request a copy of the personal information we hold about you.
Correction:
Correct inaccuracies or update your details.
Deletion:
Request deletion of your data where legally permissible.
Opt-Out:
Withdraw consent for marketing communications or specific data uses.
To exercise your rights, please contact us using the email address below.
Cookies and Third-Party Tools
Our website may use cookies, analytics tools, or third-party integrations (e.g., Google Analytics, social media plugins) to improve services. These third parties may collect data subject to their privacy policies.
Third-Party Links
Our website may contain links to external websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of third-party websites and encourage you to review their policies.
Updates to This Policy
We may revise this Privacy Policy periodically to reflect changes in our services or legal requirements. Updated versions will be posted on our website with the “Last Updated” date.
Contact Us
If you have questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your data, don’t hesitate to get in touch with us:
Human Digital Solutions

Nongprue, Banglamung, Chon Buri 20150

แพลตฟอร์มและแอปพลิเคชันที่พัฒนาขึ้นให้เหมาะกับรูปแบบการทำงานจริงของคุณ เป็นซอฟต์แวร์ที่ช่วยขับเคลื่อนการดำเนินงานของธุรกิจ ไม่ใช่แค่เว็บไซต์
คลาวด์และแพลตฟอร์มข้อมูล
โครงสร้างพื้นฐานแบบ Cloud-native และระบบส่งผ่านข้อมูลที่ออกแบบมาให้รองรับการเติบโต พร้อมทำงานได้อย่างต่อเนื่องแม้ในช่วงที่มีการใช้งานสูง
ความเป็นส่วนตัว ความปลอดภัย
และการปฏิบัติตามข้อกำหนด
ความปลอดภัยและการปกป้องข้อมูลถูกออกแบบไว้ในแกนหลักของระบบตั้งแต่วันแรก พร้อมพิสูจน์ได้ในการตรวจสอบ ไม่ใช่สิ่งที่เพิ่มเข้ามาในภายหลัง และรองรับข้อกำหนดของแต่ละตลาด
ดีไซน์ คอนเทนต์
และการเติบโต
แบรนด์ ดีไซน์ คอนเทนต์ และการค้นหา คือองค์ประกอบสำคัญในการเติบโต ที่ช่วยให้ระบบใช้งานได้จริง และทำให้ธุรกิจของคุณโดดเด่นและเป็นที่รู้จัก
พาร์ทเนอร์เดียวที่ดูแลครบทั้งสี่ด้าน เพื่อให้การทำงานแต่ละส่วนเชื่อมต่อกันอย่างราบรื่น
แพลตฟอร์มของเรา
เราไม่ได้แค่สร้างระบบ
แต่เราใช้ระบบที่เรา
สร้างขึ้นเองด้วย
uForge คือแพลตฟอร์มของเราเอง:
ที่รวมงานขาย งานสรรหาบุคลากร และงานการเงินไว้ในที่เดียว พร้อมรองรับการปฏิบัติตามข้อกำหนดของหลายประเทศตั้งแต่แกนหลักของระบบ
เราใช้ uForge ในการบริหาร werehumans และนี่คือสิ่งที่แสดงให้เห็นชัดเจนที่สุดถึงแนวคิดในการทำงานของเรา และสิ่งที่เราสามารถสร้างให้คุณได้
ข้อมูลเดียว ครบทุกขั้นตอน
รองรับข้อกำหนดตั้งแต่การออกแบบ ไม่ใช่เพิ่มเข้ามาทีหลัง
บัญชีของทุกประเทศรวมอยู่ในระบบเดียว
สำรวจ uForge
ทำไมต้อง werehumans
พาร์ทเนอร์ที่พร้อมเติบโตไปกับ
คุณ
ขับเคลื่อนด้วยงานวิศวกรรม
ทุกโปรเจกต์ของเรามีงานวิศวกรรมที่แข็งแกร่งอยู่เบื้องหลัง ไม่ใช่แค่การออกแบบแล้วส่งต่องาน เราสร้างระบบที่รองรับการใช้งานจริง พร้อมรับมือกับการใช้งานหนักและการตรวจสอบ
พาร์ทเนอร์
ไม่ใช่ผู้รับเหมา
เราให้ความสำคัญกับความสัมพันธ์ระยะยาว และยังคงดูแลสิ่งที่เราสร้างต่อไป งานของเราไม่ได้จบแค่ตอนเปิดตัว แต่เริ่มต้นจากตรงนั้น
ทางเลือกแทนทีมภายใน
คุณได้ศักยภาพของทีมพัฒนาผลิตภัณฑ์ภายในองค์กร โดยไม่ต้องแบกรับต้นทุนด้านบุคลากร กระบวนการสรรหา หรือความเสี่ยงจากการพึ่งพาคนเพียงคนเดียว
บอกเราว่าคุณอยากสร้างอะไร
ไม่ว่าจะเป็นแพลตฟอร์ม ผลิตภัณฑ์ หรือระบบที่ช่วยเชื่อมทุกส่วนของธุรกิจคุณเข้าด้วยกัน
เริ่มต้นจากการพูดคุยกับเรา
ติดต่อเรา
